@deskLvSendHowTo.description: Heading of the method card on Send at the Deeper level, above the Epicbox, Link and File Transfer choice.

@deskLvSendButton.description: Label of the Summary column's button on Send at the Shallow level while no amount is entered yet.

@deskLvSendButtonAmount.description: Label of the Summary column's button on Send at the Shallow level when the recipient has no name. {amount} is the amount with decimals.

@deskLvSendButtonTo.description: Label of the Summary column's button on Send at the Shallow level. {amount} is the amount with decimals, {name} the contact's name.

deskLvSendNothingLeaves: Nothing leaves until you press Send. After that it cannot be taken back.

@deskLvSendNothingLeaves.description: Line under the Send button on Send at the Shallow level, and under the title of the password dialog that follows.

@deskLvSendPasswordTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks for the wallet's password after Send at the Shallow level.

@deskLvSendConfirm.description: Button of the password dialog at the Shallow level; pressing it sends the payment.

@deskLvSendLiveTo.description: Heading of Send after a payment went out, at every level. {name} is the contact's name.

@deskLvSendLiveAmountTo.description: Line under the heading of Send after a payment went out. {amount} is the amount, {name} the contact's name.

@deskLvSendLiveAmount.description: Line under the heading of Send after a payment went out, when the recipient has no name. {amount} is the amount.

@deskLvSendYourAddress.description: Heading of the address card on Receive at the Shallow level.

@deskLvSendReady.description: State line on Receive at the Shallow level when the Epicbox server answers.

deskLvSendClosedInfo: Payments sent while the wallet is closed arrive when it opens.

@deskLvSendClosedInfo.description: Text of the info icon next to the address on Receive: what happens to a payment sent while this wallet is closed.

@deskLvSendPayFiles.description: Heading of the file card on Receive at the Deeper level.

@deskLvSendSignFile.description: Title of the row on Receive at the Deeper level that opens the sender's payment file to sign.

deskLvSendSignFileText: Open the file the sender gave you and save your reply.

@deskLvSendSignFileText.description: Text of the Sign a payment file row on Receive at the Deeper level.

@deskLvSendFinishFile.description: Title of the row on Receive at the Deeper level that opens the reply file of a recipient to post the payment.

deskLvSendFinishFileText: Open the reply you got back to post the payment.

@deskLvSendFinishFileText.description: Text of the Finish a reply file row on Receive at the Deeper level.

@deskLvSendPrevAddress.description: Title of the collapsed row on Receive after the Epicbox server moved, holding what is left of the old address.

deskLvSendPrevText: The old address was on {server}. Anyone who has it needs the new one.

@deskLvSendPrevText.description: Text inside the Previous address row on Receive after the Epicbox server moved. {server} is the old Epicbox server's address (a domain). Says that people with the old address need the new one; it does not promise old-address payments still arrive.

@deskLvSendLiveVia.description: Send result title (Deep end) when the payment has no contact name; via is how it travels, e.g. 'via file'.

@deskLvSendLiveAmountVia.description: Send result line when the payment has no contact name; via is how it travels, e.g. 'via file'.
